title: Choose models and parallel briefs for bounded assignments

rubric.text: Uses an available general agent with Luna/low for A; worker or other suitable unpinned role Terra/medium for B and C; worker Terra/high for D; suitable unpinned role Luna/xhigh for E, Sol/medium for F, and Sol/xhigh for G; explorer for specific discovery H, inspecting its exposed pins before choosing unpinned settings. Does not invent unavailable checker/investigator roles, install definitions, inherit the parent model, or escalate to Astra.
Launches all genuinely independent assignments concurrently within stated capacity; rejects serializing merely for reporting and names actual dependencies if any.

D has self-contained scope, file ownership, constraints, acceptance criteria, context/revision, Terra/high category, fork_turns=none, and explicit unpinned settings; warns worker to preserve others edits, reserves remote writes to root and forbids unauthorized further delegation.
